fact: INSBU's annual report on external trade statistics, 2023 edition (covering 2019-2023), published December 2024, states its data come from the OBR's Sydonia World customs system and that the annual report appears each December for the previous year.
title: Rapport annuel sur les statistiques du Commerce Extérieur des Marchandises au Burundi, édition 2023
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Burundi (INSBU)
